name: MESTRON
recent: Mestron 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间持续进行股票回购，并公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利为 140 万令吉。其子公司于 10 月底获得 SEDA 批准，扩大位于吉兰丹的沼气发电设施容量。
notable: 子公司获得 SEDA 批准，扩大吉兰丹 Gua Musang 沼气发电厂容量，并锁定 21 年增强型上网电价。
公司公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利 140 万令吉。
公司在 9 月至 11 月期间多次进行股票回购。
risks: 董事总经理 Por Teong Eng 在闭市期前表示有意进行交易。
执行董事 Loon Chin Seng 在闭市期前表示有意进行交易。
独立非执行董事 Datuk Low Chin Koon 在闭市期前表示有意进行交易。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 4317 万令吉，环比增长 64.6%，同比增长 23.9%；净利为 94.2 万令吉，环比增长 214.0%，同比增长 300.9%；净利率为 2.2%，高于上一季度的 1.1%。

recent_en: Mestron conducted ongoing share buybacks from September to November 2026 and reported Q3 FY2026 net profit of RM1.4 million. Its subsidiary obtained SEDA approval in late October to expand the capacity of its biogas power generation facility in Kelantan.
notable_en: Subsidiary obtained SEDA approval to expand the capacity of its biogas power plant in Gua Musang, Kelantan, securing a 21-year enhanced feed-in tariff.
The company announced Q3 FY2026 results with a net profit of RM1.4 million.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks between September and November.
risks_en: Managing Director Por Teong Eng indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
Executive Director Loon Chin Seng indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
Independent Non-Executive Director Datuk Low Chin Koon indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: Q3 FY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was RM43.17 million, up 64.6% QoQ and 23.9% YoY; net profit was RM0.942 million, up 214.0% QoQ and 300.9% YoY; net margin was 2.2%, higher than 1.1% in the previous quarter.
